prompt:
Architectural floor plan of one room, drawn straight from above as a clean top-down orthographic plan view in the style of a set designer's ground plan: white background, thick dark walls with gaps for doors and windows, door swings drawn as arcs, windows as thin double lines, and every piece of furniture as a simple outline from above, to scale. In the plan, its bottom edge is the front wall, its top edge the back wall, its left edge the left wall and its right edge the right wall, as the establishing view names them. Draw only the doors, windows and openings the description names. Location: INT. JI RAN'S LIVING ROOM. A spacious, stylish contemporary downtown apartment living room at night, in pale stone, warm oak and glass. Back wall: floor-to-ceiling windows with sheer curtains and a glittering night city view, which gives a cool glow from behind. Left wall: the opening to the entrance hallway, the way in, and a large abstract canvas. Right wall: an open-plan kitchen with white cabinetry and a long marble island with three bar stools, lit by a pendant above. In the middle of the room, on a large patterned rug, a long pale-oatmeal sofa stands with its back to the left wall, facing the open kitchen on the right wall. In front of it is a low marble-and-glass coffee table, with open floor between the coffee table and the kitchen island. Front wall, behind the camera: a low TV console. Warm light also comes from a brass arc floor lamp beside the sofa and soft cove lighting in the ceiling.

Avoid: people, text, labels, numbers, letters, dimensions, compass, logos, watermark, a door or window the description does not name.
